_meta.batch: Sinthia CLUE X (~53 sceny, 327 terminow) - reakcje kapitan Sinthii (teatralna nastolatka) na kazdy dowod w grze. Zawiera mechanike wyboru (Choice) w GoldenLocket/ds9 - dwie opcje odpowiedzi Grimoire'a + naglowek pytania, mowca nieprzypisany w zrodle -> standardowa konwencja 'Grimoire (opcja wyboru)' / '(naglowek wyboru)'.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json (soulTalking) - pokrycie pelne poza mechanika Choice (3 wpisy, standardowa konwencja).
_meta.character_voice: Sinthia: kontynuacja teatralnego, dramatycznego rejestru nastolatki (batch_10-11, batch_13-15).
_meta.uwagi: InnDeeds/ds8,17 - gra slow 'indeed'/'inn deed' (nazwa dokumentu brzmi jak angielskie 'w istocie'). PO PRZEGLADZIE LQA (2026-07-25, v38): rozwiazanie usera oparte na 'fakt'/'F-akt Gospody' -> 'To bezsprzeczny fakt. [h]F-akt Gospody.[/h] To bezsprzeczny [i]f-akt-[/i]' (ds8), '[i]F-akt-[/i]' (ds17) - prawdziwy homofon fakt/f-akt, bez zmiany terminologii GLOSSARY (dokument nadal 'Akt Gospody'). Pelna analiza: Docs/LQA_HUMOR_WORDPLAY_REVIEW.md #6.

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.en:
Whats with that [i]wheel?[/i] It looks kinda like a shield... does he have that in the [i]movie?
[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.pl:
Co z tym [i]kołem?[/i] Wygląda trochę jak tarcza... czy ma to w [i]filmie?
[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.en: He has a wheel in the [i]book[/i]... but it mostly stays attached to his ship - apart from one time it breaks off in a big storm.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.pl: Ma koło w [i]książce...[/i] ale przez większość czasu zostaje przyczepione do jego statku - poza jednym razem, kiedy odrywa się podczas wielkiej burzy.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ActionFigure/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.en: My parents used to shop here, from time to time...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.pl: Moi rodzice kiedyś tu robili zakupy, od czasu do czasu...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.en: They'd complain that Mr Gripp would charge them [i]full price[/i]. Even though they were locals.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.pl: Narzekali, że pan Gripp liczył im [i]pełną cenę.[/i] Mimo że byli miejscowi.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.en: Heh. Gripp's not one to give out discounts, huh?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.pl: Heh. Gripp nie jest typem, który rozdaje zniżki, co?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BalloonBasket/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: You don't wanna know what's inside?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: Nie chcesz wiedzieć, co jest w środku?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: Like... what if it's something we didn't wanna see??
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: No... a co jeśli to coś, czego nie chcielibyśmy zobaczyć??
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: I think I'd still rather know.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: Myślę, że i tak wolałbym wiedzieć.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: My mom taught me how you can use the moon to work out where you are.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: Moja mama nauczyła mnie, jak można użyć księżyca, żeby ustalić, gdzie się jest.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: Like, if you're sailing on the ocean, and you can see the moon, you can work out which way's North. I think.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: No wiesz, jeśli płyniesz po oceanie i widzisz księżyc, możesz ustalić, gdzie jest północ. Chyba.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: A co, jeśli jest zbyt pochmurno?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: Then you'd use a compass. Like a normal person.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: To wtedy użyłabyś kompasu. Jak normalny człowiek.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: This is the ship's compass? From here in the control room?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: To kompas statku? Stąd, z centrali dowodzenia?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Mhm. Looks like Mr Gripp's already working on fixing it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Mhm. Wygląda na to, że pan Gripp już go naprawia.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: The original needle was broken. Mr Gripp said he had a few he could try out as replacements.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Oryginalna igła była zepsuta. Pan Gripp powiedział, że ma kilka zamienników do wypróbowania.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Looks fine to me. Just put it back in.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Dla mnie wygląda w porządku. Po prostu ją załóż z powrotem.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Nope! Wouldn't work! It's malfunctioning - it needs to be replaced.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Nie! Nie zadziała! Jest wadliwa - trzeba ją wymienić.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: So... I notice you're the [i]captain[/i]... but you're not wearing the [i]Captain's Jacket.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Więc... zauważyłem, że jesteś [i]kapitanem...[/i] ale nie masz na sobie [i]Kurtki Kapitana.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: It's... just the way it's meant to be.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: It's based on the one [i]Mortuga[/i] had. See? The epaulettes are kinda the same.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Jest wzorowana na tej, którą miał [i]Mortuga.[/i] Widzisz? Naramienniki są podobne.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: Oh - I've been wanting to ask someone about this - how come Mortuga's jacket is like - [i]half[/i] a jacket?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Och - chciałem kogoś o to zapytać - czemu kurtka Mortugi jest jak - [i]połowa[/i] kurtki?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: Apparently he didn't wanna wear anything on his right shoulder.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Podobno nie chciał niczego nosić na prawym ramieniu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: Some kind of pain from an old injury, I think.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Jakiś ból po starej kontuzji, chyba.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: I have my [i]own[/i] jacket. [i]This[/i] one stays behind glass.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: Oh - you found the captain's log.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: So, at the end of every day you're supposed to print out one of these little cards...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Więc, na koniec każdego dnia trzeba wydrukować jedną z tych małych kartek...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: ...with readings from the submarine's movements in the last twenty-four hours...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: ...z odczytami ruchu łodzi podwodnej z ostatnich dwudziestu czterech godzin...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: So the card on the top, that's from the day Mortuga died?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Więc karta na wierzchu jest z dnia, w którym zginął Mortuga?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: ...then the captain signs it and writes about anything noteworthy that happened.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: ...a potem kapitan ją podpisuje i zapisuje wszystko, co godne uwagi się wydarzyło.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: Yeah, I - figured we should have a record of it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Tak, ja - pomyślałam, że powinniśmy mieć jakiś zapis.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: You took over as captain that same [i]night?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Przejęłaś dowództwo jako kapitan tej samej [i]nocy?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.en: Oh, I know about this one. The Silversnake.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.pl: Och, o tym to wiem. Srebrny Wąż.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.en: Well, I know it's a big sea serpent that my mom and her best friend fished outta the ocean.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.pl: Cóż, wiem, że to wielki wąż morski, którego moja mama i jej najlepsza przyjaciółka wyłowiły z oceanu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.en: What happened to it? Did she keep it?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.pl: Co się z nim stało? Zatrzymała go?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.en: Eventually some men came and took it away.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.pl: W końcu przyszli jacyś mężczyźni i go zabrali.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: [h]Aha![/h] I see you found my case file.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: [h]Aha![/h] Widzę, że znaleźliście moje akta sprawy.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: Oh, I read all about the [i]Tangle Tower[/i] case in a newspaper.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Och, czytałam o sprawie [i]Tangle Tower[/i] w gazecie.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: How come you knew about Grimoire?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: I didn't know that got any press. Someone must've sold their story...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Nie wiedziałem, że to trafiło do prasy. Ktoś musiał sprzedać swoją historię...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: I gotta ask - did Fiona end up leaving the tower? Or is she still there?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Muszę zapytać - czy Fiona w końcu wyprowadziła się z wieży? Czy nadal tam jest?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: Fifi? Yeah, she and Poppy moved out.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Fifi? Tak, ona i Poppy się wyprowadziły.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: They got a real nice place out in the countryside.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Mają naprawdę fajne miejsce na wsi.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: I never actually [i]had[/i] my own cell phone - do they all have flashlights like this?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Tak naprawdę nigdy [i]nie miałam[/i] własnego telefonu komórkowego - czy wszystkie mają takie latarki?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: Could be useful - it gets pretty dark down here.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Może się przydać - tu na dole robi się dość ciemno.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: Sinthia, is this the phone you used to call [i]us?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Sinthia, czy to jest telefon, którym zadzwoniłaś do [i]nas?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: No, I used one in the town, when I went to drop off the case file...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Nie, użyłam jednego w miasteczku, kiedy pojechałam zostawić akta sprawy...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.en: But we've both signed it! So... yep! It's binding!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.pl: Ale oboje go podpisaliśmy! Więc... tak! Jest wiążący!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.en: There it is - in black and white!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.pl: Oto i on - czarno na białym!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.en: [i]Mortuga[/i] wrote it. I think he used a typewriter.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.pl: Napisał go [i]Mortuga.[/i] Chyba użył maszyny do pisania.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.en: And - what - he presented it to you? When?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.pl: I - co - wręczył ci go? Kiedy?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.en: Well, no, cos he... he died. So.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.pl: No, nie, bo on... on umarł. Więc.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: In the case file you said the cauldron had [i]'never been unlocked before'.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: W aktach sprawy napisałaś, że kocioł [i]'nigdy wcześniej nie był odblokowany'.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: And nobody knew [h]how[/h] to unlock it - except, presumably, Mortuga himself.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: I nikt nie wiedział, [h]jak[/h] go odblokować - poza, jak przypuszczam, samym Mortugą.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: So you think it got opened in the course of the [i]murder?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: Więc myślisz, że został otwarty w trakcie [i]morderstwa?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: One; the cauldron was opened [h]before[/h] the murder.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: And three; the cauldron was opened [h]during[/h] the murder.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: I trzecia; kocioł został otwarty [h]podczas[/h] morderstwa.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: Two; someone opened the cauldron [h]after[/h] the murder.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: Like... the murder happening and the cauldron opening are [i]one and the same?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: Czyli... morderstwo i otwarcie kotła to [i]jedno i to samo?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.en: Ugh, they'd never let [h]me[/h] in. I can barely even swim.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.pl: Ugh, nigdy by [h]mnie[/h] nie przyjęli. Ledwo umiem pływać.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.en: But you live right by the sea!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.en: Pardon me for not swimming in the [i]deep freezing ocean.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.pl: Wybacz, że nie pływam w [i]głębokim, lodowatym oceanie.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DivingLicense/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: I'm sure I saw a [i]picture[/i] of this recently - but it looked different...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: Jestem pewna, że widziałam niedawno [i]zdjęcie[/i] tego - ale wyglądało inaczej...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: Uh... somewhere in the engine room?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: Mm... not really. We kinda drifted apart after-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Mm... niezupełnie. Trochę się od siebie oddaliłyśmy po-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: That's your dad on the right?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: That's a pretty fancy jacket for a [i]harbormaster[/i]. Looks more like a [i]naval[/i] officer.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: To dość elegancka kurtka jak na [i]kapitana portu.[/i] Wygląda bardziej jak oficer [i]marynarki.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: Yeah, well. She had a lot of big ideas...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Tak, no. Miała mnóstwo wielkich pomysłów...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: She was super ambitious, always making plans - my dad could barely keep up.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Była bardzo ambitna, zawsze coś planowała - mój tata ledwo nadążał.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: No he wasn't touching the [i]frame[/i], he was touching the painting itself.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Nie, nie dotykał [i]ramy,[/i] dotykał samego obrazu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: I dunno. Might be worth a second look.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Nie wiem. Może warto się temu jeszcze przyjrzeć.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: Maybe it got knocked and he was straightening it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Może został potrącony i go prostował.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: I remember one time I went into Mortuga's cabin and he was standing in front of this painting...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Pamiętam, że raz weszłam do kajuty Mortugi, a on stał przed tym obrazem...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: ...and he had his hand held up to it. Like he was touching it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: ...i trzymał uniesioną rękę przy nim. Jakby go dotykał.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: Okay, well - he is within his right to do that...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Okej, cóż - miał do tego prawo...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FilmProjector/.en: Uhh, no, I think she [i]borrowed[/i] it from somebody?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FilmProjector/.pl: Yy, nie, chyba go od kogoś [i]pożyczyła?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FilmProjector/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: -is that not just part of the design?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FogBall/Sectio.pl: -czy to nie jest po prostu część designu?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: I dunno... does it belong to [i]Madam Tadpole?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: Nie wiem... czy to należy do [i]Madam Tadpole?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: Seems like the kinda thing she might've fished outta the [i]sea...[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: Wygląda na coś, co mogła wyłowić z [i]morza...[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Sym let you see her locket...?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.pl: Sym pozwoliła wam zobaczyć swój medalion...?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Do you know what's inside? Did she ever show you?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.pl: Wiesz, co jest w środku? Kiedykolwiek ci pokazała?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: No, and I didn't ask. She's allowed to have secrets.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.pl: Nie, i nie pytałam. Ma prawo mieć swoje sekrety.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Wait - [i]you[/i] didn't open it, did you?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: You didn't open it, did you?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Was it - okay? There wasn't anything bad in there?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.pl: Czy było - w porządku? Nie było tam nic złego?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: Sinthia, this radio looks kinda like [h]you.[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: Sinthia, to radio wygląda trochę jak [h]ty.[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: Why did she take that as a compliment??
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: Czemu ona odebrała to jako komplement??
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: Of course, I brought it [i]with[/i] me - that's how I first contacted the submarine from the outside.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: Oczywiście, przywiozłam je [i]ze[/i] sobą - w ten sposób po raz pierwszy skontaktowałam się z łodzią podwodną z zewnątrz.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: You used the radio to contact Mortuga? -and you asked him to let you into the submarine?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: Użyłaś radia, żeby skontaktować się z Mortugą? -i poprosiłaś go, żeby wpuścił cię do łodzi podwodnej?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: Wait - so there's a receiver in the control room?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: Czekaj - czyli w centrali dowodzenia jest odbiornik?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.en: The stamp - that's Governor Fellow. The guy who owned Silkwirm-on-sea.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.pl: Ten znaczek - to Gubernator Fellow. Facet, który był właścicielem Silkwirm nad Morzem.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.en: I didn't know you could own a town.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.pl: Nie wiedziałam, że można być właścicielem miasteczka.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.en: Well, he [i]acted[/i] like he did. Putting himself on the stamps was the [i]least[/i] of it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.pl: Cóż, [i]zachowywał się[/i] tak, jakby był. Umieszczenie siebie na znaczkach to było [i]najmniejsze[/i] z tego wszystkiego.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HandwrittenLet.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Hey... it's that bottle I saw Dr Zephyr carrying around the submarine.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Hej... to ta butelka, którą widziałam, jak Dr Zephyr nosił po łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: What about the thing [h]in[/h] the bottle?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: A co z tym czymś [h]w[/h] butelce?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Uh - I don't really [h]want[/h] to know what that is.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Yy - tak naprawdę nie [h]chcę[/h] wiedzieć, co to jest.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Hm. Smells kinda like flowers or something. Weird.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Hm. Pachnie trochę jak kwiaty czy coś. Dziwne.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: So this is what Mr Wirman did after he left town.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Więc to zrobił pan Wirman po tym, jak wyjechał z miasteczka.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: Why would he need to leave [h]town[/h] to write a book? I feel like you could do that from [i]anywhere.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Czemu musiałby wyjechać z [h]miasteczka,[/h] żeby napisać książkę? Wydaje mi się, że można to robić [i]wszędzie.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: It was probably more about making connections.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Chodziło pewnie bardziej o nawiązywanie kontaktów.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: Silkwirm's a real [i]dead end[/i] if you've got any kind of aspirations.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Silkwirm to prawdziwy [i]ślepy zaułek,[/i] jeśli masz jakiekolwiek aspiracje.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Masz na myśli jakby w wydawnictwie?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.en: She's the theatre owner who adopted Sym.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: To właścicielka teatru, która adoptowała Sym.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.en: But I get the sense that Fortuna wasn't very [i]nice[/i] to her.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Ale mam wrażenie, że Fortuna nie była dla niej zbyt [i]miła.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.en: Did Sym [h]like[/h] living with her? -in the theatre?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Czy Sym [h]lubiła[/h] mieszkać z nią? -w teatrze?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.en: Mmm... Sym's reluctant to speak ill of her elders...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Mmm... Sym niechętnie mówi źle o starszych...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en:
We did indeed.
[h]Inn Deed.[/h]
We did [i]inn-deed-[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl:
To bezsprzeczny fakt.
[h]F—akt Gospody.[/h]
To bezsprzeczny [i]f-akt-[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: Yep. We got it. Good joke... let's move on.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Tak. Załapaliśmy. Niezły żart... idźmy dalej.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: I'm allowed to keep stuff under my mattress!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Wolno mi trzymać rzeczy pod materacem!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: Is it yours...? It doesn't have your name on it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Czy to twoje...? Nie ma na tym twojego nazwiska.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: Hmph. No it [h]doesn't[/h] - that's exactly why I brought it [i]with[/i] me, actually.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Hmph. Nie, [h]nie ma[/h] - właśnie dlatego zabrałam je [i]ze[/i] sobą, tak w ogóle.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: What d'you know about this bell?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.en:
That's no [h]bell[/h].
It's got a fluted [i]drive[/i] tip!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: For a fluted socket? With six flutes?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl: Do rowkowanego gniazda? Z sześcioma rowkami?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl:
Ohhh... tak.
Ja - zgadzam się całkowicie.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: I don't - I don't like that, it's - kinda morbid.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Nie - nie podoba mi się to, to jest - trochę makabryczne.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: So, this is the doll that apparently looks just like Sym.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Więc to jest ta lalka, która podobno wygląda dokładnie jak Sym.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: Yeah... I mean it does and it doesn-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Tak... no, wygląda i nie wyglą-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: I, uh - I'm considering having this taken down.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: Ja, yy - rozważam, żeby to zdjąć.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: -I'm Captain so I'm allowed to do stuff like that.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: -jestem Kapitanem, więc wolno mi robić takie rzeczy.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: Why would you wanna take it down?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: It's just... unnerving. It's making some of the crew uncomfortable.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: To po prostu... niepokojące. Sprawia, że część załogi czuje się niekomfortowo.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.en: Hey! There's a document in there!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.pl: Hej! Tam w środku jest dokument!
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.en: It's a piece of [i]paper[/i], I dunno if I'd call it a [h]document.[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.pl: To kawałek [i]papieru,[/i] nie wiem, czy nazwałbym to [h]dokumentem.[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.en: ...apart from the [i]title[/i], which is drawn by hand.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.en: Oh yeah. It almost looks like a logo for something...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.pl: O tak. Wygląda niemal jak logo czegoś...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: That's my mom, standing in the harbor...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: To moja mama, stoi w porcie...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: ...and that's my dad, standing under the lighthouse.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: ...a to mój tata, stoi pod latarnią morską.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: Hey, the lighthouse opens up... and there's a film reel in there.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Hej, latarnia się otwiera... i jest tam szpula filmowa.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: Uh, that is [h]not[/h] accurate. We did [h]not[/h] have a giant film reel in our attic.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Yy, to jest [h]nie[/h]dokładne. [h]Nie[/h] mieliśmy gigantycznej szpuli filmowej na strychu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: You know... if this [h]is[/h] poison, then surely it's a red herring.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: Wiecie... jeśli to [h]jest[/h] trucizna, to na pewno fałszywy trop.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: Right. So - you think someone put it there as a false lead?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: No dobra. Więc - myślisz, że ktoś to tam podłożył jako fałszywy trop?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: I dunno... it's not a very [i]good[/i] false lead.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: Nie wiem... to nie jest zbyt [i]dobry[/i] fałszywy trop.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: I guess he must be. He told me he's getting all [i]kinds[/i] of offers from other studios.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Chyba musi być. Powiedział mi, że dostaje wszelkiego [i]rodzaju[/i] oferty od innych wytwórni.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: Lucky him. He must be thrilled.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: You know, this article's kind of unfair to Dirk - it barely [i]mentions[/i] him.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Wiecie, ten artykuł jest trochę niesprawiedliwy dla Dirka - ledwo o nim [i]wspomina.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: Probably because it was written [i]before[/i] the movie came out. So, he wasn't famous yet.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Pewnie dlatego, że został napisany [i]przed[/i] premierą filmu. Więc jeszcze nie był sławny.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: The movie was a [i]hit[/i], right? So, Dirk's famous [i]now?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Film był [i]hitem,[/i] prawda? Więc Dirk jest [i]teraz[/i] sławny?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: I remember this. My mom had a copy framed and put it up in our hallway.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Pamiętam to. Moja mama miała oprawioną kopię i powiesiła ją w naszym korytarzu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: That's her best friend. They were always going on little adventures together-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: To jej najlepsza przyjaciółka. Zawsze razem wyruszały na małe przygody-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: -and one time... they came back with a sea serpent.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: -i pewnego razu... wróciły z wężem morskim.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Also known as the Silkwirm Serpent.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Znany też jako Wąż z Silkwirm.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Nope, no eyes. And its skin was rock hard, but shiny, like a gemstone.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Nie, żadnych oczu. A jego skóra była twarda jak skała, ale błyszcząca, jak klejnot.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Where'd you keep it? In the shipyard?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Yeah. Mom wanted to take it back into the sea... but she didn't wanna [i]leave[/i] it. She wanted to go [i]with[/i] it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Tak. Mama chciała zabrać go z powrotem do morza... ale nie chciała go [i]zostawić.[/i] Chciała popłynąć [i]razem[/i] z nim.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: She wanted [h]all[/h] of us to go.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Why'd they take it out of the [i]ocean[/i], anyway?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: A czemu w ogóle wyciągnęły go z [i]oceanu?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Uh - it was... injured? They wanted to look after it until it recovered.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Yy - był... ranny? Chciały się nim zaopiekować, aż wyzdrowieje.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: To go... and live in the ocean.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Żeby popłynąć... i zamieszkać w oceanie.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.en: You're looking at it upside down.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.pl: Patrzysz na to do góry nogami.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: D'you know what [i]'The Stargazing Girl'[/i] is all about?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.pl: Wiesz, o czym jest [i]'Dziewczyna Patrząca w Gwiazdy'?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: No, Sym didn't tell me the details.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.pl: Nie, Sym nie powiedziała mi szczegółów.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: She didn't [h]want[/h] to, for some reason. She seemed to regret the whole thing.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.pl: Z jakiegoś powodu nie [h]chciała.[/h] Wydawała się żałować całej tej sprawy.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SeaChart/Secti.en: It looks kinda like that thing Mortuga kept up on the fore deck.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SeaChart/Secti.pl: Wygląda trochę jak ta rzecz, którą Mortuga trzymał na dziobowym pokładzie.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SeaChart/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipinaBottle/.en: I [i]know[/i] this ship... I used to look out my bedroom window, and see it sitting in the harbor.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipinaBottle/.pl: [i]Znam[/i] ten statek... kiedyś wyglądałam przez okno swojej sypialni i widziałam go stojącego w porcie.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipinaBottle/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: How come there's two different wheels?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: The big wooden one's for steering left and right.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.pl: To duże drewniane jest do skręcania w lewo i prawo.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: The smaller one's for diving and surfacing.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.pl: To mniejsze jest do zanurzania i wynurzania.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: Speaking of, what does the [i]'S'[/i] stand for?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.pl: A skoro już o tym mowa, co oznacza to [i]'S'?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: Sinthia - this map's got your [i]surname[/i] on it - and the [i]'S'[/i] from your signature.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.pl: Sinthia - na tej mapie jest twoje [i]nazwisko[/i] - i [i]'S'[/i] z twojego podpisu.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: I mean, nobody ever really [i]called[/i] it that - but my mom [i]was[/i] the harbormaster, so, yeah.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.pl: No, tak naprawdę nikt tego tak nigdy [i]nie nazywał[/i] - ale moja mama [i]była[/i] kapitanem portu, więc, no tak.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: Seawater can [i]really[/i] do a number on electronics, you gotta be careful.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Woda morska potrafi [i]naprawdę[/i] narobić szkód w elektronice, trzeba uważać.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: Give us your professional opinion. Laser gun? Shrink ray?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Podaj nam swoją profesjonalną opinię. Działko laserowe? Promień kurczący?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: Also it's [i]damaged[/i] - it's starting to rust, and there's sediment in the joints...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Poza tym jest [i]uszkodzona[/i] - zaczyna rdzewieć i w złączach jest osad...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: Given its messy history? [i]Yes it is![/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.pl: Biorąc pod uwagę jej burzliwą historię? [i]No pewnie![/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: What are you trying to [i]do[/i], exactly?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: I'm [h]trying[/h] to get a handle on the exact form of the submarine.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.en: Yeah. For when you need sunlight, but you can't get any.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.pl: Tak. Na wypadek, gdy potrzebujesz światła słonecznego, ale nie możesz go zdobyć.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.en: Like if you - I dunno, random example - [i]lived in a submarine.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.pl: Na przykład, gdybyś - nie wiem, przypadkowy przykład - [i]mieszkała w łodzi podwodnej.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE SunTablets/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: I don't think Wirman [h]wants[/h] anyone to fix it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Nie sądzę, żeby Wirman [h]chciał,[/h] żeby ktoś to naprawiał.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: It's a [h]mess[/h] - the keys are all in the wrong place...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: To [h]bałagan[/h] - klawisze są wszystkie w złych miejscach...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: I could fix it for him, no problem. Or - Mr Gripp could do it, I bet.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Mogłabym to dla niego naprawić, bez problemu. Albo - pan Gripp mógłby to zrobić, założę się.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: The night of the murder, when I was in the control room by myself...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: Tej nocy, kiedy doszło do morderstwa, gdy byłam sama w centrali dowodzenia...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en:
But then [h]this[/h] came out...
I wish I hadn't done it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl:
Ale potem wyszło [h]to[/h]...
Chciałabym, żebym tego nie zrobiła.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: I put it in the safe so I wouldn't have to think about it.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: Włożyłam to do sejfu, żeby nie musieć o tym myśleć.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en:
I locked it in the safe...
I didn't think-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl:
Zamknęłam to w sejfie...
Nie pomyślałam-
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: ...it was right around the time the ship's compass was freaking out...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: ...to było mniej więcej wtedy, kiedy kompas statku wariował...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: You used the underwater imaging system?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en:
I don't know why.
I - couldn't resist.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl:
Nie wiem czemu.
Ja - nie mogłam się powstrzymać.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: Yeah. Sometimes you gotta compartmentalize. One thing at a time, you know?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: Tak. Czasem trzeba to sobie poukładać w głowie. Jedna rzecz na raz, wiesz?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: There he is, Mortuga's little mascot.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Oto i on, mała maskotka Mortugi.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: Oh, you know, bit of this, bit of that - a big green light shines out of his eyes sometimes.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Och, no wiesz, trochę tego, trochę tamtego - czasem z jego oczu bije wielkie zielone światło.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: Yeah - we [i]saw[/i] it. It lured us onto the submarine.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Tak - [i]widzieliśmy[/i] to. Zwabiło nas na łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: How does it work? Do you activate it from in here?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Jak to działa? Aktywujesz to stąd?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Nie. To po prostu jakby samo się dzieje.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: [i]Wooden - buoy - is - confirmed - to - be - magical.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: Wait, so it's a [i]casette[/i] player. For listening to music?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.pl: Czekaj, więc to odtwarzacz [i]kaset?[/i] Do słuchania muzyki?
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: Looks like the [i]tape[/i] can swap out...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.pl: Wygląda na to, że [i]taśmę[/i] można wymienić...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: So maybe there are other tapes.
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: Hey, yeah! I bet there are...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.pl: Hej, no tak! Założę się, że są...
Conversation/Sinthia CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.issue: Gra slow 'indeed'/'Inn Deed' nieprzekladalna doslownie (dokument nazywa sie tak, ze brzmi jak angielskie 'w istocie'). Zastosowano funkcjonalny zamiennik 'otoz to' / 'o, toz to' zachowujacy komiczny rytm rozbicia slowa, ale nieoparte na nazwie dokumentu 'Akt Wlasnosci'. Do przemyslenia/potwierdzenia z userem.

Tytul ksiazki/opowiadania Sym "'The Stargazing Girl'" przetlumaczony roboczo jako "'Dziewczyna Patrząca w Gwiazdy'" - brak wczesniejszego wystapienia tego tytulu w innych batchach do potwierdzenia spojnosci nazwy.
